import re

def parse(lines):
    cre = re.compile(r'^class\s+(?P<name>\S+)(?:\s+\[(?P<bases>.*)\])?\s+(?P<line>\d+)\s*$')
    dre = re.compile(r'^(?P<ind>\s*)def\s+(?P<name>\S+)\s+(?P<line>\d+)\s*$')
    classes = []
    cl = []
    methods = []
    ml = []
    funcs = []
    fl = []
    cur = None
    for i, l in enumerate(lines):
        m = cre.match(l)
        if m:
            cur = m.group('name')
            classes.append({'class': cur, 'bases': m.group('bases') or '', 'line': int(m.group('line'))})
            cl.append(i)
            continue
        m = dre.match(l)
        if m:
            if m.group('ind') and cur is not None:
                methods.append({'class': cur, 'method': m.group('name'), 'line': int(m.group('line'))})
                ml.append(i)
            else:
                cur = None
                funcs.append({'function': m.group('name'), 'line': int(m.group('line'))})
                fl.append(i)
    blocks = []
    if classes:
        blocks.append({'name': 'classes', 'kind': 'table', 'lines': cl, 'records': classes})
    if methods:
        blocks.append({'name': 'methods', 'kind': 'table', 'lines': ml, 'records': methods})
    if funcs:
        blocks.append({'name': 'functions', 'kind': 'table', 'lines': fl, 'records': funcs})
    return {'blocks': blocks, 'skip': []}
